articles.title: Open USD rattled Circle's stock, but its key backers still support USDC
articles.snippet: Executives at Coinbase, Visa and Mastercard said they plan to support multiple stablecoins, suggesting Open USD is another payments rail rather than a direct replacement for USDC.

articles.title: Samsung is poised to become a dominant stablecoin distributor, analysts say
articles.snippet: Samsung seeks to turn 800 million Galaxy phones into wallets for digital assets and blockchain payments, backed by a deeper play in crypto infrastructure.

articles.title: Clarity Act sits idle over Trump ethics question as Warren asks SEC to investigate him
articles.snippet: Senators Elizabeth Warren and Richard Blumenthal requested the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission probe Trump's memecoin.

articles.title: Wells Fargo joins JPMorgan and Citi in the race to tokenize Wall Street’s settlement rails
articles.snippet: Payments will run on the bank’s proprietary blockchain and be routed automatically through its existing client interface.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s $63,000 zone emerges as key battleground for buyers: Glassnode
articles.snippet: Retail investors and large whales are buying as bitcoin trades near its 200-week moving average.
